title: The First Good Words: The Seed of the Remembering Tongue (2-3 Years)
description: A path to assist parents in planting the first words of dhikr and adab in their toddler’s tongue: the basmalah, al-ḥamd, salām, and the good word—and the first adab by qudwah (example), not talqīn (instruction).
